nodes.description: address payable[] array of current players; written in receive(), read/deleted in play(), clearPlayers(), random(), getPlayerCount().
receive() payable external: validates msg.value >= 0.01 ether, pushes msg.sender into players, triggers play() when two players.
internal play(): picks winner from players via flipTheCoin(), clears players, and pays out the whole balance.
public view getBalance(): returns address(this).balance, used as payout amount.
private payOut(address,uint): performs a low-level value transfer to a caller/player-controlled address.
internal clearPlayers(): deletes the players array (state reset before payout).
private view flipTheCoin(): returns random() % 2, i.e. the winner index.
public view random(): derived from block.difficulty, block.timestamp and players.length via keccak256, i.e. predictable/weak randomness.
Caller address; attacker-controlled, becomes a player and can later receive the payout.
Miner/validator-influenced timestamp used as entropy in random().
Low-level _to.call{value:_amount}("") external value transfer to a player-controlled address before the call returns (only the require on the boolean result follows).
Weak/unpredictable randomness source: keccak256(block.difficulty, block.timestamp, players.length) decides the money winner.
Recipient parameter of payOut, derived from the winner index into players.
Amount parameter of payOut, equal to the contract balance.
Local player address selected by flipTheCoin() and passed to payOut.
Boolean result of the low-level call in payOut, checked by require(sent).

edges.reason: msg.sender is the untrusted entry point into receive().
msg.sender is pushed into the players state array.
getPlayerCount reads players.length.
play() indexes players with the coin flip result to choose the winner.
players.length is used as part of the randomness seed in random().
receive() calls getPlayerCount() to decide whether to start a round.
receive() calls play() when the player count reaches two.
play() calls flipTheCoin() to select the winner.
play() calls clearPlayers() before paying out.
play() calls payOut(winner, getBalance()).
play() calls getBalance() for the payout amount.
The contract balance is passed as _amount to payOut.
clearPlayers() deletes the players state array.
flipTheCoin() calls random() for its result.
random() consumes block.timestamp as entropy.
block.timestamp feeds the weak randomness source.
random() produces the miner-influenceable randomness value used to pick the winner.
The coin flip result inherits the weak randomness of random().
payOut executes the unchecked-recipient external value call.
The external call can re-enter receive() (the attacker is already a player) while the payout is in flight.
The selected winner controls the recipient of the external call.
payOut._to (the winner) is the target of the external call.
payOut._amount (contract balance) is the value sent in the external call.
payOut.sent captures the boolean outcome of the external call.
play() stores the coin-flip result in the winner local variable.

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient parameter is only consumed by the low-level value transfer in payOut; fold it into the unsafe_operation node.
Amount parameter exists solely to supply the value forwarded by the external call; fold it into the unsafe_operation node.
Local winner variable is only used as the argument to payOut and thus designates the recipient of the external call.
Local boolean is just the raw outcome of the external call, so it belongs to the unsafe_operation node.
